items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: See all of us played with Rene. Yeah. My brother-law August played with him, my brother Clarence played with him, my brother Manny played with him and I played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's when I knew him. But he'd talk about music. He didn't turn his back on the music world or anything. No. He was a very open, honest, and funny sort of guy. He had a good sense of young.
He was a different attitude than his brother. Oh yeah. Kid Rene was more a ladies man. Yeah.
I guess Joe was too fat for that.
